description: This Java class handles commands to add a family member to a client within the Fineract platform. It is part of the command handling infrastructure, specifically for creating family member records linked to clients.

classes.name: AddClientFamilyMemberCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class that processes requests to add a new family member to a client account.

methods.name: AddClientFamilyMemberCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the service responsible for managing client family members.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to add a family member, delegating to the platform service.
